name: PinballNS Vita
author: astro-plane
description:
This is the PS Vita / PS TV port of Pinball NS by Reinhard Sharapov. In the original Game Boy Color game, each table is split into a top half and a bottom half, and the screen goes blank while the other half loads. Pinball NS joins them into a single field: both halves run together, and the ball rolls from one to the other with no loading. The original physics are kept, so it plays like the cartridge.
The Vita Edition adds a native ARM front-end. The Game Boy's CPU is emulated in ARM assembly written for the Vita's Cortex-A9, so the game runs at full speed.
